endpoint: Discover short exact principal relations among exactly the twenty frozen E302 half ideals, construct their integer relation lattice, and promote only exact short square-ideal relations to the strict-class test.
inputs: The immutable completed first-20 target list, E302 equation/S/maximal order, and generic M17 Kummer arithmetic. Public E302 points, M24 and public strict witnesses are excluded.
method: Enumerate signed exponent states e with l1 norm at most three. Hash their canonically reduced ideal representatives. Each collision supplies a proposed direct principal relation, which is exactly principalized before it enters the integer relation lattice R. HNF gives a lattice basis; its LLL basis is retained. Solve R intersect 2Z^20 by an exact integer kernel, divide by two, LLL-reduce, and enumerate only basis vectors and pairwise plus/minus combinations with nonzero parity masks. Every square-ideal candidate is exactly principalized before strict-local correction and generic-character exclusion. Candidates are ranked by support, exponent size, and generator size.
failure_semantics: The finite short relation collection is a discovery procedure, not a complete class-group computation. A missing collision or strict candidate does not exclude longer relations. A collision is not promoted without an exact principal-ideal identity. A strict class is not a rational point until separate post-hoc M24 exclusion and a witness-hidden cover solve complete.
